body:
## Outcome

Publish the complete, reviewed v0.92.2 planning package and open its execution wave one carefully reviewed sprint at a time.

## Current authorized scope

The operator authorized issue creation after review of PR #865. The current batch is the first C-SDLC simplification sprint only: umbrella #866 and SIM-01 through SIM-09 (#867–#875). Review every body before creation and verify the published body, identity, milestone, label and numeric dependencies after native creation. Preserve every complete-task contract and all seven planning tasks.

The planning wave remains 69 tasks: nine earlier issue bindings plus ten new first-sprint bindings, with 50 tasks still unassigned. The eight task-family splits and eleven tightened completion contracts remain in force. OBS-S3 and ARCH-ADR explicitly gate final TAIL-10 completion; integration precedes independent installed-product qualification.

## Deliverables and acceptance

- [ ] Complete canonical planning package, issue wave, execution specifications, atomic contracts, WBS, catalog, sprint/readiness and release gates agree.
- [ ] The first sprint has exactly ten unique issues with one complete result each, concrete owned paths, dependencies, success/failure proof, PVF classification, stop conditions and non-goals.
- [ ] SIM-03's complete installed-command inventory is frozen before creation and included in #869.
- [ ] Authenticated native creation/readback evidence proves correct title, body, version label, milestone and numeric dependency links; no duplicate issues or silently omitted tasks.
- [ ] All ten published issues receive careful independent review; actionable findings are fixed before launch evidence is published.
- [ ] Planning and launch negative fixtures, native six-card validation, links and diff hygiene pass; final exact-head review precedes PR update.

## Boundaries

Creation and review of this first sprint is authorized. Implementation starts only through each issue's own native readiness/binding route. No writer pause, live conversion/activation, Runtime/provider interruption, paid resources, merge or release approval is authorized by this launch. Later sprint creation is a subsequent batch after this batch's review, preserving each task's selection gates.

## Source and evidence

`docs/milestones/v0.92.2/`; `.csdlc/evidence/864/sprint01-launch/`; the reviewed atomic-task and final-closeout correction in PR #865. Prior number-free/no-child instructions describe the earlier preparation phase and are superseded for this first batch by the operator's explicit creation instruction. Historical evidence remains unchanged.

Validation: `python3 docs/milestones/v0.92.2/validate_planning.py --self-test`; `python3 .csdlc/evidence/864/sprint01-launch/validate_launch.py`; native v3 `validate`; focused link and diff checks. These establish planning/issue-launch truth, not implemented Beta 1 behavior.

Owned paths: `docs/milestones/v0.92.2/**`, native `.csdlc/issues/864/**`, `.csdlc/evidence/864/**` and native transaction records. PR #865 uses `Closes #864`.
